description: This file defines a controller class 'Free' for the OpenCart admin extension related to shipping. It handles displaying and saving configuration settings for free shipping, including rendering views, handling user permissions, loading models, and managing configuration data.

classes.name: Free
classes.description: Controller class for managing free shipping settings in OpenCart's admin interface.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the free shipping configuration page, loading language, models, configurations, and setting up view data including breadcrumbs and common page sections.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving updated free shipping settings, including permission checks, updating settings via model, and returning JSON response.
